COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

Pemberwick Lane Holdings, LLC
Wexmoor Commons Building, 418 Tarrow Street, Harrowgate Falls, Ohio

This Commercial Lease Agreement (this "Lease") is made as of March 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Pemberwick Lane Holdings, LLC, an Ohio limited liability company ("Landlord"), and Marrow and Thistle Goods LLC, an Ohio limited liability company ("Tenant"), and Dana R. Ostrander, an individual and the managing member of Tenant ("Principal").

1. STANDARD TERMS

1.1 This Lease is Landlord's standard form of lease for the Wexmoor Commons Building, and its terms are not subject to negotiation or modification.

1.2 Principal joins in this Lease in Principal's individual capacity for the purposes stated in Sections 9 and 10. Tenant's obligations under this Lease are guaranteed by Principal under a separate Guaranty of Lease dated the same date as this Lease.

2. PREMISES

2.1 Landlord leases to Tenant, and Tenant leases from Landlord, the ground-floor retail unit known as Suite 104 in the Wexmoor Commons Building, 418 Tarrow Street, Harrowgate Falls, Ohio (the "Building"), containing approximately 1,350 rentable square feet (the "Premises").

2.2 Tenant may use, in common with other tenants of the Building, the sidewalks, the rear loading area and the customer parking lot serving the Building (the "Common Areas").

2.3 Landlord shall deliver the Premises to Tenant on the Commencement Date with the existing storefront, restroom and electrical service in working order.

3. TERM

3.1 The initial term of this Lease begins on April 1, 2026 (the "Commencement Date") and ends on March 31, 2029 (together with any renewal term, the "Term").

3.2 This Lease automatically renews for successive three-year terms on the same terms unless Tenant gives Landlord written notice of non-renewal no earlier than 120 days and no later than 90 days before the end of the then-current term.

4. RENT

4.1 Tenant shall pay base rent of $2,475.00 per month ("Rent"), payable in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term.

4.2 Rent for any partial month at the beginning of the Term will be prorated on a daily basis.

4.3 Tenant shall pay Rent by check delivered to Landlord's office or by electronic transfer to the account Landlord designates in writing.

4.4 If any Rent is not received by the fifth day of the month, Tenant shall pay a late charge equal to fifteen percent of the overdue amount plus interest at eighteen percent per year until paid.

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT

5.1 On signing this Lease, Tenant shall deliver to Landlord a security deposit of $4,950.00 (the "Security Deposit").

5.2 Landlord may apply all or any part of the Security Deposit to any repair, cleaning or restoration that Landlord in its sole discretion deems necessary, and Tenant shall replenish the Security Deposit within five days after demand.

5.3 Landlord shall return any remaining balance of the Security Deposit to Tenant within thirty days after the end of the Term, together with a written statement of any amounts applied.

6. USE OF PREMISES

6.1 Tenant shall use the Premises only for the retail sale of candles, home goods, stationery and gifts, and for activities customarily incidental to that use.

6.2 Tenant shall keep the Premises open for business during reasonable hours consistent with other retail tenants of the Building.

6.3 Tenant shall comply with all laws, ordinances and regulations that apply to Tenant's business at the Premises.

6.4 Tenant shall comply with the Building rules and regulations posted in the rear corridor of the Building (the "Rules and Regulations").

6.5 Landlord may amend the Rules and Regulations or any other term of this Lease at any time by written notice to Tenant, and each amendment takes effect on the date stated in the notice.

7. UTILITIES

7.1 The Premises are separately metered for electricity and natural gas, and Tenant shall arrange and pay for those services directly with the providers.

7.2 Landlord shall provide water and sewer service to the Premises, and the cost of those services is included in Rent.

7.3 Tenant shall arrange and pay for its own telephone, internet and trash removal services.

8. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS

8.1 Landlord shall keep the Common Areas clean, lit and reasonably free of snow and ice.

8.2 Tenant shall, at Tenant's sole cost, make all repairs and replacements to the Premises, including the roof, structure and building systems serving the Premises, using contractors approved by Landlord.

8.3 Tenant shall keep the interior of the Premises in a clean and orderly condition.

8.4 Tenant shall not make structural alterations to the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent.

9. INDEMNITY

9.1 Tenant and Principal, jointly and severally and in Principal's individual capacity, shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Landlord and its agents from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, fines, costs and attorneys' fees arising from Tenant's use or occupancy of the Premises, without limit as to amount.

9.2 Tenant shall maintain commercial general liability insurance covering the Premises with limits of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and shall deliver a certificate of that insurance to Landlord before the Commencement Date.

10. RESTRICTIVE COVENANT

10.1 During the Term and for two years after it ends, Principal shall not personally own, operate, manage or be employed by any retail business selling goods similar to those sold at the Premises within a five-mile radius of the Building.

11. SIGNS

11.1 Tenant may install one exterior sign above the storefront of the Premises, consistent in size and placement with the signs of other tenants of the Building.

11.2 Tenant shall remove its sign at the end of the Term.

12. QUIET ENJOYMENT

12.1 So long as Tenant pays Rent and performs its obligations under this Lease, Tenant may peaceably and quietly hold and enjoy the Premises during the Term.

12.2 Landlord may enter the Premises during business hours on twenty-four hours' notice to inspect them or to show them to prospective buyers or lenders.

13. SURRENDER

13.1 At the end of the Term, Tenant shall surrender the Premises broom clean, with Tenant's trade fixtures and personal property removed.

14. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

14.1 Any dispute arising out of this Lease shall be resolved by binding arbitration administered by a single arbitrator, and Tenant waives any right to bring or participate in any class or collective action against Landlord.

15. NOTICES

15.1 All notices under this Lease must be in writing and delivered by hand, by certified mail, or by a nationally recognized overnight courier.

15.2 Notices to Landlord must be sent to Pemberwick Lane Holdings, LLC, 22 Fenwright Avenue, Suite 300, Harrowgate Falls, Ohio 44960.

15.3 Notices to Tenant and to Principal must be sent to the Premises.

15.4 A notice is effective on the date it is delivered or on the date delivery is refused.

16. GOVERNING LAW

16.1 This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

16.2 The Court of Common Pleas of Wexmoor County, Ohio, has jurisdiction to enter judgment on any arbitration award and to hear any action for possession of the Premises.

17. GENERAL PROVISIONS

17.1 This Lease, together with the Rules and Regulations, is the entire agreement between the parties about the Premises and replaces all prior discussions and proposals.

17.2 The section headings in this Lease are for convenience only and do not affect its meaning.

17.3 If any provision of this Lease is held invalid, the remaining provisions remain in effect.

17.4 This Lease binds and benefits the parties and their permitted successors and assigns.

17.5 Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent.

17.6 This Lease may be signed in counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which together are one instrument.

18. SIGNATURES

The parties have signed this Lease as of the Effective Date.
